name: Purrimeter — The Garden Guard
subtitle: Build a maze with claws
description:
Purrimeter is an endless pixel-art tower defence game. Enemies cross your square garden from the entrance to the exit; you recruit cats, place them to build a maze, and keep the swarm from escaping.

BUILD A MAZE WITH CLAWS
Three cat types, each with a purchased form plus five upgrades: quick shots, splash damage and slowing attacks. Enemies take the shortest open route, so every cat you place reshapes the path. Block them completely and they claw through the quickest breach instead, and foes that backtrack too long enter a frenzy.

ENDLESS PROGRESSION
Every level doubles total enemy health and raises the bounty. One escape loses the attempt and sends you back a level, keeping your coins, upgrades and surviving cats. Clear level five and Rebirth becomes available: return to level one with your coins and cats, and choose one permanent Rebirth Draft improvement.

YOUR GARDEN STAYS WITH YOU
Coins, cats, powerups, discoveries, draft improvements and rebirth bonuses live in your garden on this device. Thirty achievements and unlockable cat skins carry across every garden. Export and import your garden to move it between devices or browsers.

PLAY ALONGSIDE FRIENDS
Multiplayer gardens hold up to three players. Everyone defends their own garden and progresses independently while watching one another play and chatting. Open games can be password protected, and you can mute or report other players at any time.

MADE FOR TOUCH
Landscape layouts, pinch to zoom, drag to pan, tap any cat or enemy to inspect it, and a tactical pause for building and repairs.

Free, no ads, no purchases, no account. The same game is available for Android, browsers, macOS and Windows at purrimeter.graham.pub, and a multiplayer server can be self-hosted.

review.notes:
PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Purrimeter is a free pixel-art cat tower defence game. Players recruit cats and place them on a garden grid to build a maze that stops waves of enemies. It is a casual strategy game for a general audience of teens and adults. There are no accounts, logins, ads, purchases, subscriptions, or tracking.

HOW TO ACCESS THE MAIN FEATURES
Single player works fully offline and needs no credentials or sample files.
1. Launch the app and tap Single player.
2. Tap Recruit, choose a cat, tap an empty tile, then Confirm.
3. Tap Start to begin the first wave. Tap any cat or enemy to inspect it. Powerups opens upgrades and, after clearing level five, Rebirth.
4. Menu pauses combat and offers Sound, Export/Import, New Garden, Help, and return to the main menu.
Multiplayer is optional. On the main menu tap Multiplayer, then Create a game or Join a game. Up to three players each defend their own garden and cannot affect each other's gameplay.

USER-GENERATED CONTENT AND MODERATION
The only user-generated content is chosen player names and chat text inside a multiplayer game, visible only to the up-to-three players in that game. Tap Chat to type and send. In the chat panel, beside each other player's name (next to each message on larger screens), are Mute, which hides that player's messages for you, and Report, which mutes the player and sends their recent messages, chosen name, and installation identifier to Roundhouse Labs for review. The game owner can Kick a player. Reports are reviewed by us and retained for 90 days; ordinary chat is not stored. Open games can be password protected. Contact: ryan@roundhouselabsinc.com.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app uses only our own multiplayer server, operated by Roundhouse Labs Inc. at purrimeter.graham.pub, for multiplayer games, chat, abuse reports, and checking the current game release. No third-party SDKs, analytics, advertising, authentication, payment, or AI services are used. The game is built with the open-source Godot engine.

REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. Features and content are identical in every region, and there is one global multiplayer server.

REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. All art, music, and code are original works owned by Roundhouse Labs Inc.

SCREEN RECORDING
The attached recording was captured on the iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.2) because no physical device was available. It begins at launch and shows single player (recruiting and placing cats, a wave, inspection, Powerups, and the Menu), then multiplayer: creating a game, a second player joining from the browser build, chat, Mute and Unmute, and Report with its confirmation.

The multiplayer server requires its current game release. While this build is awaiting review, single player remains fully available and multiplayer may require the update once approved. Support: ryan@roundhouselabsinc.com.
